The '''Republic Detention Center''', named '''RDC PolAx''' in [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|GAR]] signals, was a facility located in [[Pols Anaxes]] that was converted into a [[Prison/Legends|detention center]] from an old [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] training branch facility. [[Ruusaan Skirata]] was being held as a prisoner of war in the center's [[Hut Eight Bravo]] wing, around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Order 66" />

[[Bardan Jusik]], [[Fi Skirata]], and former [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] [[Spar]] and [[Sull]] rescued Ruusaan while posing as three regular [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and Bardan as a detainee brought to "identify" the prisoner. The facility was commanded by a [[Unidentified clone trooper lieutenant (Pols Anaxes)|clone trooper lieutenant]] from the [[55th Mechanized Brigade]]. Fi thought this was a waste of the lieutenant's skills until he noticed that the lieutenant had been wounded, which gave hope that there was a soldiering life after being injured.<ref name="Order 66" />
